title: Line hub
features: Line hub script universal roblox para todos os jogos
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Line Hub 👿 ULTIMATE EDITION",
   LoadingTitle = "Protocolo Final: Velocidade Máxima",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Tudo Incluído - Sem Bugs",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false }
})

local lp = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- 🚀 ABA DE MOVIMENTAÇÃO (SPEED, JUMP, FLY, NOCLIP)
local MoveTab = Window:CreateTab("Movimento 🚀", 4483362458)

MoveTab:CreateSection("Velocidade & Pulo")

MoveTab:CreateSlider({
   Name = "Velocidade de Caminhada (Speed)",
   Range = {16, 500},
   Increment = 5,
   CurrentValue = 16,
   Callback = function(v)
       if lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
           lp.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = v
       end
   end,
})

MoveTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Resetar Velocidade (16)",
   Callback = function()
       if lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
           lp.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
       end
   end,
})

local InfiniteJumpEnabled = false
MoveTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Infinite Jump (Pulo Infinito)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v) InfiniteJumpEnabled = v end,
})

MoveTab:CreateSection("Especiais")

MoveTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "EXECUTAR FE FLY ORIGINAL (Botão)",
   Callback = function()
       loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XNEOFF/FlyGuiV3/main/FlyGuiV3.lua"))()
   end,
})

local noclip = false
MoveTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Noclip (Atravessar Paredes)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
       noclip = v
       RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
           if noclip and lp.Character then
               for _, part in pairs(lp.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                   if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
               end
           end
       end)
   end,
})

-- 😈 ABA TROLL
local TrollTab = Window:CreateTab("Troll 😈", 4483362458)

local flinging = false
TrollTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Fling (Expulsar Jogadores)",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
       flinging = v
       if flinging then
           local bam = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", lp.Character.HumanoidRootPart)
           bam.P = 9e4; bam.maxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0); bam.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 99999, 0)
           task.spawn(function()
               while flinging do
                   for _, part in pairs(lp.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                       if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
                   end
                   task.wait()
               end
               bam:Destroy()
           end)
       end
   end,
})

local Spaming = false
local SpamText = "Line Hub 👿"
TrollTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Texto do Spam",
   PlaceholderText = "Digite...",
   Callback = function(t) SpamText = t end,
})

TrollTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Chat Spammer",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
       Spaming = v
       task.spawn(function()
           while Spaming do
               local chat = game:GetService("TextChatService"):FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
               if chat then chat.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(SpamText) end
               local oldChat = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
               if oldChat then oldChat.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(SpamText, "All") end
               task.wait(2)
           end
       end)
   end,
})

-- 🎭 ABA UTILIDADES
local UtilsTab = Window:CreateTab("Utilidades 🎭", 4483362458)

UtilsTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Ativar Anti-AFK",
   Callback = function()
       lp.Idled:Connect(function()
           game:GetService("VirtualUser"):Button2Down(Vector2.new(0,0), Camera.CFrame)
           task.wait(1)
           game:GetService("VirtualUser"):Button2Up(Vector2.new(0,0), Camera.CFrame)
       end)
       Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Line Hub", Content = "Anti-AFK Ativo!"})
   end,
})

local TargetSkin = ""
UtilsTab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Roubar Skin (Nome)",
   PlaceholderText = "Ex: Roblox",
   Callback = function(t) TargetSkin = t end,
})

UtilsTab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Aplicar Skin",
   Callback = function()
       pcall(function()
           local id = game.Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(TargetSkin)
           local app = game.Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(id)
           for _, v in pairs(lp.Character:GetChildren()) do
               if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") then v:Destroy() end
           end
           for _, v in pairs(app:GetChildren()) do v.Parent = lp.Character end
       end)
   end,
})

-- LOGICA DE PULO INFINITO
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if InfiniteJumpEnabled then
        lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState("Jumping")
    end
end)

Rayfield:Notify({Title = "LINE HUB 👿", Content = "Speed Hack adicionado! Agora estás completo."})
